title: Pure Fairy Tail
summary: Pure Fairy Tail 1850-ATK Spellcaster control build led by the 2026 Blazing Dominion wave (Fairy Tail - Matchgiru, Fairy Tail Ball, Teller of Fairy Tails, Weaver of Fairy Tails, and Fairy Tail - Wiccat), with generic staples. Matchgiru and Fairy Tail Ball rename an opponent's monster into Prince of Fairies so Tails of the Fairy Tails can fuse it away into your Extra Deck bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fairy Tail - Luna searches any Spellcaster with 1850 ATK from the Deck on Normal Summon (finding any Main Deck Fairy Tail monster).
Fairy Tail - Matchgiru Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an 1850 original ATK Spellcaster, searches any Fairy Tail Spell/Trap, and renames an opposing monster Prince of Fairies.
Fairy Tail Ball searches a Fairy Tail card on activation, while Fairy Tail Tales grants an extra Normal Summon of an 1850 ATK Spellcaster each turn.

summary.title: Opening: Fairy Tail - Luna + Fairy Tail - Matchgiru
steps: Normal Summon Fairy Tail - Luna and use its trigger effect to search Fairy Tail - Matchgiru (or Fairy Tail - Snow if you already have Matchgiru).
Special Summon Fairy Tail - Matchgiru from your hand and search Fairy Tail Ball (or Tails of the Fairy Tails).

Activate Fairy Tail Ball to search Once Upon a Fairy Tail or Tails of the Fairy Tails, then fuse into Weaver of Fairy Tails to Special Summon another Fairy Tail from the Deck (or overlay two Level 4s into Fairy Tail - Wiccat).
On the opponent's turn, Fairy Tail Ball negates and renames a monster they summon into Prince of Fairies, letting Tails of the Fairy Tails fuse it away into Teller of Fairy Tails to wipe their field.

summary.title: Prince of Fairies Super-Poly Loop
summary.text: Both Fairy Tail - Matchgiru and the Field Spell Fairy Tail Ball change an opponent's monster's name to Prince of Fairies (with Ball also negating its effects when summoned). Once an opposing monster is named Prince of Fairies, the Equip Spell Tails of the Fairy Tails can use that opponent's monster as Fusion Material to Fusion Summon Teller of Fairy Tails—which destroys all cards your opponent controls when Fusion Summoned using Prince of Fairies as material.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Teller of Fairy Tails wipes the opponent's field when Fusion Summoned with Prince of Fairies and banishes cards on the opponent's turn.
Weaver of Fairy Tails Special Summons a Fairy Tail monster directly from the Deck and negates an opposing monster's effects.
Fairy Tail - Wiccat (Rank 4 Xyz) makes your LIGHT Fairy Tail monsters unaffected by the opponent's activated effects.

Fairy Tail - Luna targets an opponent's face-up monster as a Quick Effect to return both itself and that monster to the hand (unless the opponent sends a duplicate from their Deck/Extra Deck to the GY), while Limited Fairy Tail - Snow banishes 7 other cards to summon itself from the hand or GY as a Quick Effect and flip an opposing monster face-down.

summary.title: Spells
points: Once Upon a Fairy Tail (Quick-Play) Special Summons up to 3 LIGHT Fairy Tail monsters—one each from your hand, GY, and banishment.
Fairy Tail Tales reveals an 1850 ATK Spellcaster in hand for an additional Normal Summon and reduces the first battle or effect damage you take each turn to 0.
Fairy Tail - Sleeper summons a monster from the hand on Flip and rewrites an opponent's Normal Spell/Trap into flipping Sleeper face-down.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's White Forest and Azamina hybrid engines are omitted to keep the build pure Fairy Tail. Note that the HTML page uses pre-release fan translations for the 2026 wave (Matchlille, Wickat, Tales of Fairy Tail, Fairy Tail Long Long Ago), whereas this list uses their official TCG names.

Fairy Tail - Luna
Normal Summoned: searches an 1850 ATK Spellcaster; bounces itself and their monster on either turn.
Fairy Tail - Rochka
Normal Summoned: the opponent picks one of your top three cards for you.
Fairy Tail - Sleeper
Flip: summons a monster from the hand; rewrites their Normal Spell/Trap.
Fairy Tail - Rella
Shields monsters from Spell targeting and borrows an Equip Spell.
Fairy Tail - Snow
Limited. Flips a monster face-down; returns from the GY by banishing seven.
Fairy Tail Ball
2026 support. Field Spell: searches a Fairy Tail; negates and renames a monster when they summon.
Once Upon a Fairy Tail
2026 support. Quick-Play: summons a LIGHT Fairy Tail each from your hand, GY and banishment.
Tails of the Fairy Tails
2026 support. Equip that Fusion Summons a Spellcaster, using their Prince of Fairies.
Fairy Tail Tales
Extra Normal Summons for 1850 Spellcasters, and blocks damage once a turn.
